headline: Japan's INPEX Starts Production at Marjoram Gas Field Offshore Malaysia
summary: INPEX Corporation commenced natural gas extraction at the Marjoram field offshore Sarawak, Malaysia, expanding its upstream Asian output.
why: INPEX is Japan's flagship oil and gas exploration company, playing a vital role in national energy security.

impacts.name: INPEX
impacts.why: INPEX brought a new offshore Malaysian gas field into commercial production.
